articles.title: OpenAI Launches GPT-5 with Extended Reasoning and Native Multimodal Generation
articles.summary: OpenAI officially released GPT-5, featuring significantly improved long-horizon reasoning, native image and audio generation within a single model, and a vastly expanded context window exceeding 1 million tokens. The model demonstrates substantial gains on PhD-level science benchmarks and complex multi-step coding tasks, narrowing the gap between AI assistants and domain experts.

articles.title: Google DeepMind's Gemini Robotics Models Enable Dexterous Manipulation in Unstructured Environments
articles.summary: DeepMind unveiled its latest Gemini Robotics foundation models that combine vision-language understanding with fine-grained motor control, allowing robots to manipulate deformable and fragile objects like fabric and glassware with near-human dexterity. The system uses a sim-to-real transfer pipeline that drastically reduces the real-world training data required for new tasks.

articles.title: Anthropic Introduces Constitutional Classifiers v2 to Harden AI Systems Against Jailbreaks
articles.summary: Anthropic published research on Constitutional Classifiers v2, a defense-in-depth system that reduced successful jailbreak rates on Claude to under 1% across comprehensive red-team evaluations. The approach layers input and output classifiers trained via constitutional AI principles, providing a composable safety layer that other model providers can also integrate.

articles.title: Tesla Optimus Robots Begin Limited Deployment in Third-Party Warehouses
articles.summary: Tesla confirmed that a small fleet of Optimus Gen-3 humanoid robots has begun supervised pick-and-pack operations in select third-party logistics warehouses, marking the first commercial deployment outside Tesla's own factories. The robots leverage onboard vision transformers for object recognition and path planning, though they still require human teleoperation fallback for roughly 8% of encountered edge cases.

articles.title: Meta Open-Sources Llama 4 Behemoth with Mixture-of-Experts Architecture at 1.2 Trillion Parameters
articles.summary: Meta released Llama 4 Behemoth, its largest open-weight model to date, using a sparse mixture-of-experts design that activates only a fraction of its 1.2T parameters per forward pass, making inference feasible on multi-GPU clusters rather than supercomputers. Early benchmarks show it rivaling proprietary frontier models on code generation and multilingual reasoning, further shifting the competitive dynamics between open and closed AI ecosystems.

articles.title: TSMC Begins Volume Production of 1.4nm-Class N14P Process Node
articles.summary: TSMC announced that its N14P process node—utilizing gate-all-around nanosheet transistors at a 1.4nm-class density—has entered high-volume manufacturing ahead of schedule. The node delivers an estimated 15% speed improvement and 30% power reduction over N2, and is expected to power next-generation AI accelerator and mobile SoC designs shipping in early 2027.

articles.title: Neuralink Receives FDA Clearance for Expanded Brain-Computer Interface Trial in Spinal Cord Injury Patients
articles.summary: The FDA granted Neuralink approval to expand its PRIME clinical trial to include patients with spinal cord injuries, beyond the initial ALS cohort, allowing participants to control robotic limbs and digital interfaces via implanted electrode arrays. Early data from the initial cohort showed sustained high-bandwidth neural decoding exceeding 12 months without signal degradation, a milestone for long-term BCI viability.

articles.title: Boston Dynamics and Hyundai Unveil Atlas Commercial Platform with Swappable Tool Hands
articles.summary: Boston Dynamics and parent company Hyundai launched the commercial Atlas platform featuring a modular quick-swap hand system that lets operators reconfigure the humanoid for welding, inspection, or heavy lifting in under 60 seconds. The platform ships with an updated autonomy stack built on transformer-based world models, enabling the robot to plan multi-step manipulation sequences from natural language task descriptions.
